email.subject: Breakwater Group Fitness: a couple of quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I took a look at Breakwater Group Fitness's website. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no mobile-friendly layout, so anyone checking class times on their phone has a hard time, and there's no online booking, so people have to call during hours instead of signing up on the spot. The footer also shows outdated info, and hours aren't listed anywhere on the site.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change, no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
